Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting kidney dialysis patients from therapeutic consultation service requirements.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting kidney dialysis patients fromrequirements of the therapeutic consultation service; and adding a newsection to chapter 74.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Drug claims for kidney dialysis patients who are medical assistanceclients are not required to be submitted to a therapeutic consultationservice based on the number of brand name prescriptions prescribed percalendar month for the client.
